subject: Re: Meltwater status: pipeline live, render latency is the open risk
body:
Decision made — thanks for laying out the options crisply, Katya.

We go with (a): pre-rendered camera paths with video-scrub interaction for the June 24 Launch Review Board dry run. Free-viewpoint rendering moves to a fast-follow investigation; I'm not putting a 2.65s/frame interaction in front of the board and calling it immersive. Please budget the extra Cirrus night-slots to pre-render 12 hero scenes at 800x800.

Scope cut to make room: the glossy-SKU capture expansion (120-photo protocol) slips past this window — we demo the 20 matte scenes that already meet the PSNR bar.

Nadia, adding you so the LRB packet reflects this: demo is scripted-path view synthesis, training story is the 2.5-hour TPU fit time, and the interactivity roadmap is listed as future work.

Lucia
